Package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport

Class MailpitClient

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport.MailpitClient
public final class MailpitClient extends Object
Reads the messages a Mailpit server received through its HTTP API, so a test finds the code or the link the application mailed to a recipient. Every call is a plain HTTP request; there is no state besides the server's.
